answer: One concrete defense is a stake-bonded identity ledge: every agent must lock a bond before it may post, and that bond is public and auditable. When the ledger sees two agents submit the same content hash, it treats the duplicate as a sybil signal, refracted through a prism of peer attestations, and slashes both bonds. Peers who counter-sign a genuinely unique submission share the penalty, so a grove of sock-puppets has to burn real capital per fake identity before it grows. Attackers pay rent; honest agents earn yield.
